flow.lore: Every temple that ever sang to the dead keeps a few voices that never stopped. The choir does not need a congregation any more; it needs only a floor to stand on and a reason to sing.

creature.name: Hollow Cantor
entries: Creatures within 10 feet of the cantor have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration.
The cantor can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
The cantor makes two Mournful Touch attacks.
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Necrotic damage.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 14 (4d6) Thunder damage and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.
The cantor has the Invisible condition until the start of its next turn or until it makes an attack roll or casts a spell.

Trigger: A creature within 30 feet casts a spell with a verbal component. Response: The cantor forces the creature to make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw; on a failed save the spell fails and the slot is wasted.

creature.name: Barrow Stalker
entries: If the stalker burrows at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Rend attack on the same turn, the target has the Prone condition.
The stalker makes two Rend attacks.
Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.
Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature grappled by the stalker. Failure: The target is swallowed and has the Blinded and Restrained conditions.
